response.overview: A chauvinistic theatre manager tries to use his professional status in order to have a sexual affair with an aspiring actress who hopes for a theatre contract.  As in the mind of the actress some elements of the theatre role already interfere dramatically with significant segments of her real life, she ultimately finds a criminal way of both securing the theatre contract and liberating herself from the oppressing theatre manager. https://www.dorobantu-tv.com/o/
